profile: Ademola Habeeb is a website designer and WordPress developer focused on clear, conversion-minded websites for businesses.

answers.title: Services
answers.answer: Htech designs and builds WordPress business websites, Elementor pages, landing pages and WooCommerce stores. Ademola also works on redesigns and improvements to existing websites, with attention to clear messaging, mobile usability and the next step for visitors.

answers.title: Project fit
answers.answer: The best starting point is your business goal and what you want visitors to do—make an enquiry, explore your services, book or buy. Share your business type and the key action you want customers to take, and Ademola can suggest a practical direction.

answers.title: Pricing and quotes
answers.answer: Project cost depends on the scope, pages, content, functionality and platform requirements. Htech does not publish a one-size-fits-all price here. Share what you need and your target budget, and Ademola can discuss a suitable scope and quote.

answers.title: How projects work
answers.answer: The project process is: discovery, planning, design, WordPress development, testing and launch. You review progress at clear milestones, and the project begins by clarifying your business, audience, goals and required pages.

answers.title: Project timelines
answers.answer: Timing depends on the project scope, how quickly content and feedback are ready, and any special functionality. Share your target launch date and a short brief so Ademola can confirm what is realistic for your project.

answers.title: Existing websites and redesigns
answers.answer: Yes—Htech can discuss improvements to an existing website, including its layout, mobile experience, content structure, performance or WordPress setup. Share the public website URL and the main issue you want to solve for a more useful first response.

answers.title: Portfolio and examples
answers.answer: You can explore projects in the portfolio, including e-commerce, automotive, legal coaching, wellness and photography websites. The examples show the kind of page structures and WordPress work Htech can discuss for your own project.

answers.title: Working together
answers.answer: Ademola is based in Lagos, Nigeria, and works with local and international clients remotely. Project conversations can be handled through WhatsApp, email, Upwork or LinkedIn.

answers.title: Speak with Ademola
answers.answer: Absolutely. You can message Ademola directly on WhatsApp at +234 813 767 7307, email him, or use LinkedIn. The WhatsApp link can include a short summary of what you shared here, and the email link can include the chat transcript.

answers.title: Free Growth Check
answers.answer: Growth Check is Htech’s free guided tool. If you already have a public website, it can scan the site and highlight practical opportunities. If you do not have a website yet, it helps shape a business-specific starting blueprint.

personalizedGuidance.online-store: For an online store, the brief should cover your products, checkout, shipping and how customers will find the right items.
personalizedGuidance.service-business: For a service business, focus the brief on your services, proof and trust, and the enquiry or booking action you want visitors to take.
personalizedGuidance.existing-site: For an existing site, include its URL and the main issue you want to address—such as mobile usability, content, speed or functionality.
personalizedGuidance.new-site: For a new website, start with your audience, offer, main goal, essential pages and the content you already have.
personalizedGuidance.general: Tell me what your business does and what you want customers to do on the website, and I can make the next suggestion more relevant.
